CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the task. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Description.description_en: The description of the task provided when the task is created
Description.description_zh: 创建任务时填写的任务说明
Description.example: 盘点订单库的业务知识。

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

JobId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge inventory task

KnowledgeCnt.description_en: The number of knowledge items inventoried in the task, which is the sum of the counts of all knowledge types
KnowledgeCnt.description_zh: 本次任务统计的知识数量，为各知识类型数量之和

Progress.description_en: The execution progress of the task, in percentage. It is calculated as the average progress of all subtasks. If there are no subtasks, the value is 0
Progress.description_zh: 任务执行进度，单位为百分比。由各子任务进度的平均值计算；没有子任务时为 0

ShowJobId.description_en: The task number for display. If the task ID is less than 1000, it is padded to four digits. For example, if the task ID is 1, TASK_0001 is displayed
ShowJobId.description_zh: 用于展示的任务编号。任务 ID 小于 1000 时补足四位数字，例如任务 ID 为 1 时显示 TASK_0001

Status.description_en:
The status of the knowledge inventory task. Valid values:
INIT: The task is created.
RUNNING: The task is running.
INTERCEPT: The task is interrupted.
FAILED: The task failed.
OVER: The task is terminated.
SUCCESS: The task succeeded
Status.description_zh: 知识盘点任务状态。INIT：新建；RUNNING：执行中；INTERCEPT：中断；FAILED：失败；OVER：终止；SUCCESS：成功

Supplement.description_en: The supplementary information provided when the task is created
Supplement.description_zh: 创建任务时填写的补充信息
Supplement.example: 重点梳理订单与支付数据的关系。

TableCnt.description_en: The number of tables involved in the task
TableCnt.description_zh: 本次任务涉及的表数量

description_en: Queries the execution status and progress information of an asset information collection task
description_zh: 查询资产盘点任务的执行状态与进度信息
name: CheckInventoryJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inventory task
parameters.name: job_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
